summary: No new role cleared every hard gate on November 3. Two postings not previously covered on this site were examined, and both are near-misses: vector8’s Senior AI/ML Engineer, France builds client LLM agents and workflows, and Mistral AI’s AI Scientist, Agentic CAD trains LLMs for computer-aided design. Both are AI-central and hybrid, but neither publishes pay or a Paris office-day rule. Earlier picks and near-misses that are unchanged are not repeated. These entries are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: Automated official-ATS sweep on November 3: 131 of 276 attempted Ashby, Lever and Greenhouse board aliases returned data; many failed aliases are likely wrong board names, not evidence of no vacancies. The sweep screened AI-titled roles on reachable boards, Paris- or France-located engineering roles with published pay on reachable Ashby boards, Greenhouse and Lever data for 109 France-located engineering roles (31 with pay text), and Ashby engineering roles first published since November 2 with a France or Europe-remote location. Compared with November 2’s sweep, it surfaced no new AI-titled requisition in France; the Mistral AI role, first published November 2, was already in that sweep’s data but was not examined in the November 2 report. A second pass reached 42 of 300 attempted aliases, a Workable and Recruitee check reached 6 of 44, and a pass over 105 additional company names reached 49 of 315 attempted aliases. Ten web searches were used for discovery only; leads found there were checked on employer boards, which added the vector8 requisition. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE, unlabelled pay ranges and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked November 3, 2026. The vector8 page shows no posting date; third-party sites first showed it within the last day, so it is treated as new to this site, not as a dated new requisition.
Unpublished pay is recorded as unknown, not as below the threshold. Neither employer publishes a salary figure for these roles.
Job aggregators show salary ranges for some Paris AI roles, including vector8 (€100,000–€150,000). Those figures are not employer-published and were not used.
The November 2 near-misses and rejections (Veepee, Doctolib, Doctrine, Uncovr, Winamax) are still listed. They stay in the November 2 archive and are not repeated.

Earlier picks that remain listed with unchanged terms, including OpenAI Deployment Company’s Forward Deployed Engineer - EU (October 18), n8n, Inato and Pigment, stay in their original archives and are not counted today.

Search leads not confirmed on an employer board today were not counted. These include recruiter posts and aggregator-only salary figures. Mendo’s Senior AI Engineer listing now returns HTTP 410, and a Finom remote role was not confirmed on its employer board.
Deduplication covered the accessible October 10 to November 2 reports and the supplied October 3/5 Escape history.
Company financial diligence was not advanced because no role was ranked; the product notes are employer-stated only.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. Zero new roles qualified today. vector8 and Mistral AI would each need a published base salary above €100,000 (or at least €80,000 with explicit equity) and a stated Paris office-day rule before reconsideration. No applications or outreach were made.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer, France
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing header: “Permanent · Hybrid · France, France”; body: “The role is primarily based in Paris with a proportion of the time spent working with stakeholders on client sites.” The number of office or client-site days is not stated.[1]

salary.quote: The employer listing says only “Competitive salary package”, with no figure and no equity term. A third-party job site shows €100,000–€150,000, but that figure is not employer-published and was not used; a €100,000 floor would also not be strictly above €100,000 without explicit equity. Pay is unknown.[1]

reasons: Pay gate unverified: the employer publishes no salary figure or equity.[1]
Location is not established: the listing is hybrid and “primarily based in Paris”, but it states no office-day rule and includes client-site time.[1]

AI centrality passes: “Design and build agents and AI workflows, including tool integration, orchestration, guardrails and human validation steps” and “Integrate LLMs, retrieval and classical ML or speech models with clients' existing systems and data.”[1]

Seniority passes (Senior; 5+ years in AI/ML engineering, software development or a related field). The listing requires fluent English and French. New to this site’s history; the employer page shows no posting date. The application tab on the same listing rendered a form on the check date.[1][2]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: vector8 is an AI consultancy that designs, develops and delivers production AI solutions for clients, from agentic systems to LLM, classical ML and speech solutions, with a focus on regulated industries (security, compliance, access control, legacy integration). This role builds client agents and workflows, evaluation, tracing and MLOps.[1]
jobs.financials: Not publicly verified in this run. The careers page lists open roles in France, Switzerland, the UK and North Macedonia; no headcount, funding or revenue figure was checked.[2]

jobs.title: AI Scientist, Agentic CAD (AI4Engineering)
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: location “Paris; Amsterdam; Berlin; Linz; London; Munich; Palo Alto”, location type “Hybrid”. No office-day rule is stated.[3]

salary.quote: No salary range or equity term is published, and the official Ashby data has no compensation tier. Pay is unknown, not below the threshold.[3][4]

reasons: Pay gate unverified: no employer-published salary or equity.[3][4]
Location is not established: Paris is one of seven listed hubs and the role is hybrid, but no attendance rule is stated.[3]
AI centrality passes: the role is about “teaching Mistral's LLMs to generate, analyze, and modify CAD designs”, building pre- and post-training data, verifiers and agent harnesses.[3]

This is a research-scientist seat that asks for “Demonstrated hands-on CAD experience” as well as agentic-system and reward-modeling experience, so it is narrower than a general AI engineering role. First published November 2, 2026 per the official Ashby data. The application form rendered on the check date.[3][4]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: Mistral builds frontier models, developer tools, applications and compute. The AI4Engineering Science team builds data and evaluation infrastructure and runs SFT/RL for models that do engineering work; this seat covers text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation, CAD part analysis and design modification, plus agent scaffolding for multi-step CAD workflows.[3]
jobs.financials: Not publicly verified in this run; no funding, revenue or headcount source was checked today.
